principles: Id = Id0 * exp((Vgs-Vth)/(n*Vt)) where Vt = kT/q ~ 26mV at 27C
gm = Id/(n*Vt) — proportional to bias current, not geometry
gm/Id ratio peaks in subthreshold (~25-30 V^-1 for SKY130 NMOS)
Output resistance ro = VA/Id where VA = Early voltage
Intrinsic gain Av = gm*ro = VA/(n*Vt) — independent of bias current in subthreshold
sky130_specifics: NFET Vth ~ 0.4-0.5V (increases with L due to reduced DIBL)
Minimum L = 0.15um (digital); L >= 1um recommended for analog matching
MIM cap: 2 fF/um^2, max 400um per side
Pseudo-resistor: back-to-back PMOS L=10 W=0.42 gives > 1TOhm
design_rules: At VDD=0.9V with Vth~0.45V, headroom for one NFET+one PFET stack is marginal
Cascode stacks NOT feasible at VDD=0.9V subthreshold
Sub-threshold operation means exponential sensitivity to Vth mismatch

principles: Alpha = C_sample / (C_sample + C_ewma) — set by cap ratio
Requires sample cap to be fully charged before sharing — settling time critical
Settling time = 14*tau for 99.99% accuracy where tau = R_source * C_sample
sky130_specifics: Need 55ms capture pulse for full settling (14 * 3.88ms)
Capacitor leakage ~15pA parasitic — causes drift on large caps over seconds
design_rules: Always propagate IC between simulation batches for EWMA circuits
Capture pulse duration must be >> tau_SF, not just a brief clock edge
Alpha error = exp(-t_capture/tau) — at 0.5ms capture: 88% error

principles: Diode load: Av = gm_input / gm_load ~ 1 for matched devices
Active mirror load: Av = gm_input * (ro_input || ro_load) ~ 20-50 in subthreshold
Gain tuning via W_diode: smaller W_diode -> less damping -> higher gain
sky130_specifics: For ECG features needing 225mV+ span, diode-only (gain~1) is insufficient
Hybrid sweet spot: mirror W=2 + diode W=0.42-2.0 gives gain 1.7-3x

principles: 1T1R cell: access NMOS in series with ReRAM
Column current = sum of row voltages * conductances (analog MAC)
Read voltage must be below disturb threshold
sky130_specifics: LRS range: 30-120 uS; HRS: < 0.1 uS (> 10 MOhm)
Up to 3 bits (8 levels) demonstrated; 4-bit not feasible
Conductance drift: intermediate states drift over hours
